newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt police arrest 29 alleged Brotherhood members.
newsitem.headline: Egypt police arrest 29 alleged Brotherhood members.

text.p: Egyptian police have arrested 29 men, including five journalists, on suspicion of belonging to the outlawed and influential Moslem Brotherhood, Egypt's largest political Islamic group, security sources said on Saturday.
They said the men were picked up at the house of a lawyer on Friday during a meeting that police say was to prepare for next week's local elections.
Egyptian law bars anyone from carrying out any activity in the name of the Brotherhood.
No comment from the Brotherhood was available on police allegations that the detained men belong to the organisation.
Two of the journalists write for pro-Islamist al-Sha'ab bi-weekly newspaper.
The Egyptian government says the Brotherhood is a front for violent Moslem militant groups which are trying to turn Egypt into a strict Islamic state.
The Brotherhood denies the charge, saying it wants to use legal methods, such as elections, to bring about its version of an Islamic state.
